modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (foot) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Embiid missed Saturday's 109-104 win over Charlotte due to right foot plantar fascia injury management, and he's now in jeopardy of missing a second consecutive game for the same reason. If he's unable to play Monday, Adem Bona will likely earn another start with Jabari Walker getting additional minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) is questionable to play Monday against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Johnson did not return to Saturday's 121-99 loss to New Orleans after suffering a left ankle sprain in the third quarter. He's now been tagged as questionable, and if he is in fact out versus Indiana, Aaron Wiggins and Luguentz Dort are the top candidates to join the starting five for Atlanta.

injury.shortComment: Smith (finger) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Smith is battling a finger injury but is expected to suit up versus the 76ers. With Nicolas Claxton (hamstring) listed as doubtful, Smith will presumably remain in the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Barnes (hip) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Barnes is dealing with left hip soreness and could miss the second leg of this back-to-back set. The star forward's absence would open up additional minutes for the likes of Collin Murray-Boyles, Jamison Battle and Allen Graves.

injury.shortComment: Poeltl (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Poeltl was a late scratch ahead of Sunday's loss to the Lakers and is in jeopardy of missing a second straight game due to left shoulder bursitis. If the big man is unable to suit up, Collin Murray-Boyles and Trayce Jackson-Davis would be candidates for increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Murray (personal) is now questionable for Monday against Memphis.
injury.detail: Murray, who has missed the past two games for the birth of his son, was previously left off the injury report for this contest. With this possible change of plans, the Pelicans may need to rely on Herbert Jones again if Murray is unable to join the team.

injury.shortComment: Awaka (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Awaka played 12 minutes during Friday's 125-111 loss to the Celtics after missing one game with the ankle issue. The rookie big man will continue to provide depth off the bench for the Bulls behind Jalen Smith.

injury.shortComment: Toppin (back) is questionable for Monday's game against Atlanta.
injury.detail: Toppin remains day-to-day after missing the first leg of this back-to-back set. The Pacers could give him extended run if he's cleared to play with so many regulars sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Watson (hamstring) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Oklahoma City.
injury.detail: Watson is battling soreness in his right hamstring, an ailment that has put his status for Monday's contest in jeopardy. With Jaylon Tyson (ankle) already ruled out, the Cavs could be thin on the wings, while Sam Merrill, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas would all stand to see increased playing time if Watson is forced to miss his first outing of the season.

injury.shortComment: Nance (illness) is doubtful for Monday against the Hawks.
injury.detail: Nance is usually not a big factor in the rotation, but his expected absence is a big blow this time around -- the Pacers are going to be extremely thin at every position Monday.

injury.shortComment: Shannon has a left hip contusion and is questionable to face the Bucks on Monday.
injury.detail: Shannon could join Anthony Edwards (knee) on the sidelines, potentially leaving Minnesota thin on the wing. His absence would create additional opportunities for the Timberwolves' remaining perimeter players such as Bones Hyland and Ayo Dosunmu.

injury.shortComment: Irving (knee) is now doubtful for Monday against the Kings.
injury.detail: The Mavericks originally listed Irving as questionable, but he's expected to miss his second game of the season. The team will be hoping he's ready to return Wednesday against San Antonio. Walter Clayton and Marcus Sasser could see extra run in Irving's expected absence.

injury.shortComment: LaVine (elbow) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Dallas.
injury.detail: LaVine played a season-low 21 minutes during Saturday's 136-105 loss to Memphis, but it's unclear if that was due to the elbow soreness or the game being out of reach for the Kings. Either way, his status will bear monitoring ahead of Monday's clash with the Mavericks. If he's unable to play, Darius Acuff Jr.'s usage would skyrocket, while Malik Monk, Emanuel Sharp and Nique Clifford could all see increased opportunities in the backcourt.

injury.shortComment: Post (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Post missed Saturday's 136-105 victory over Sacramento with a sprained right ankle, and he's now in jeopardy of missing a second straight contest with the injury. If he's unable to play, Isaiah Stewart and Taylor Hendricks will split the backup center minutes.

injury.shortComment: Ball is questionable for Monday's game against Milwaukee due to a right wrist contusion.
injury.detail: Ball's status is uncertain heading into Monday's matchup, leaving Minnesota's backcourt potentially shorthanded. With Anthony Edwards (knee) already ruled out, Ball's availability will be particularly important for the Timberwolves' offensive production. Bones Hyland and Ayo Dosunmu could be heavily involved if Ball is absent.

injury.shortComment: Sheppard (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Sheppard is in danger of missing his fourth game of the 2026-27 campaign. With Fred VanVleet (knee) not listed on the injury report, Marcus Smart could continue to be more involved than usual if Sheppard can't suit up Monday.

injury.shortComment: Williams (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Suns.
injury.detail: Williams is dealing with a left quadriceps contusion and could sit out the back end of this back-to-back set. If the 26-year-old guard is unable to suit up, Will Richard and De'Anthony Melton could see increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Flemings (suspension) won't play in Monday's game against Indiana, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Flemings was assessed a technical foul and ejected late in the Hawks' 121-99 loss to New Orleans on Saturday for intentionally elbowing Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head. Without the rookie on the floor, head coach Quin Snyder will presumably divide the minutes between Dyson Daniels, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Aaron Wiggins and CJ McCollum.

injury.shortComment: Pippen (back) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
injury.detail: Pippen didn't suit up for Saturday's 136-105 win over the Kings. With Pippen in line to miss another game Monday, Cam Spencer will likely be on the floor more than usual behind Ty Jerome (back), who is not listed on the injury report for the meeting with New Orleans.
